description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific Stripe price using its unique ID. Use when you need to fetch price details.

inputSchema.description: Specifies the price ID to retrieve.

price.description: The unique identifier of the price to retrieve. This ID typically starts with 'price_'.
price.title: Price

inputSchema.title: GetPricesPriceRequest

name: get_prices_price

custom_unit_amount.description: Configuration for customer-adjustable amounts in this currency.
custom_unit_amount.title: Custom Unit Amount

tax_behavior.description: Specifies whether the price is considered inclusive of taxes or exclusive of taxes for this currency. One of 'inclusive', 'exclusive', or 'unspecified'.
tax_behavior.title: Tax Behavior

tiers.description: Each element represents a pricing tier for this currency.
tiers.title: Tiers

unit_amount.description: The unit amount in cents to be charged, represented as a whole integer for this currency.
unit_amount.title: Unit Amount

unit_amount_decimal.description: The unit amount in cents to be charged, represented as a decimal string with at most 12 decimal places for this currency.
unit_amount_decimal.title: Unit Amount Decimal

maximum.description: The maximum unit amount the customer can specify for this price.
maximum.title: Maximum

minimum.description: The minimum unit amount the customer can specify for this price.
minimum.title: Minimum

preset.description: The starting unit amount which can be updated by the customer.
preset.title: Preset

GetPricesPriceResponse.description: Response containing the retrieved Stripe Price object.

active.description: Whether the price can be used for new purchases.
active.title: Active

billing_scheme.description: Describes how to compute the price per period. Either 'per_unit' or 'tiered'.
billing_scheme.title: Billing Scheme

created.description: Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
created.title: Created

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase.
currency.title: Currency

currency_options.description: Prices defined in each available currency option.
currency_options.title: Currency Options

custom_unit_amount.description: When set, provides configuration to enable adjusting quantity by the customer.
custom_unit_amount.title: Custom Unit Amount

id.description: Unique identifier for the price object.
id.title: Id

livemode.description: Has the value true if the object exists in live mode or the value false if the object exists in test mode.
livemode.title: Livemode

lookup_key.description: A lookup key used to retrieve prices dynamically from a static string. Maximum of 200 characters.
lookup_key.title: Lookup Key

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.
metadata.title: Metadata

nickname.description: A brief description of the price, hidden from customers.
nickname.title: Nickname

object.description: String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value. Value is 'price'.
object.title: Object

product.description: The ID of the product this price is associated with.
product.title: Product

recurring.description: The recurring components of a price such as interval and usage_type.
recurring.title: Recurring

tax_behavior.description: Specifies whether the price is considered inclusive of taxes or exclusive of taxes. One of 'inclusive', 'exclusive', or 'unspecified'.
tax_behavior.title: Tax Behavior

tiers.description: Each element represents a pricing tier. This parameter requires billing_scheme to be set to 'tiered'.
tiers.title: Tiers

tiers_mode.description: Defines if the tiering price should be 'graduated' or 'volume' based. In volume-based tiering, the maximum quantity within a period determines the per unit price. In graduated tiering, pricing can change as the quantity grows.
tiers_mode.title: Tiers Mode

transform_quantity.description: Apply a transformation to the reported usage or set quantity before computing the amount billed.
transform_quantity.title: Transform Quantity

type.description: One of 'one_time' or 'recurring' depending on whether the price is for a one-time purchase or a recurring (subscription) purchase.
type.title: Type

unit_amount.description: The unit amount in cents to be charged, represented as a whole integer if possible.
unit_amount.title: Unit Amount

unit_amount_decimal.description: The unit amount in cents to be charged, represented as a decimal string with at most 12 decimal places.
unit_amount_decimal.title: Unit Amount Decimal

GetPricesPriceResponse.title: GetPricesPriceResponse

flat_amount_decimal.description: Same as flat_amount, but contains a decimal value with at most 12 decimal places.
flat_amount_decimal.title: Flat Amount Decimal

unit_amount.description: Per unit price for units relevant to the tier.
unit_amount.title: Unit Amount

unit_amount_decimal.description: Same as unit_amount, but contains a decimal value with at most 12 decimal places.
unit_amount_decimal.title: Unit Amount Decimal

up_to.description: Up to and including this quantity will be contained in the tier.
up_to.title: Up To

RecurringResponse.description: The recurring components of a price such as interval and usage_type.

interval.description: The frequency at which a subscription is billed. One of 'day', 'week', 'month' or 'year'.
interval.title: Interval

interval_count.description: The number of intervals between subscription billings.
interval_count.title: Interval Count

meter.description: The meter tracking the usage of a metered price.
meter.title: Meter

usage_type.description: Configures how the quantity per period should be determined. Either 'metered' or 'licensed'.
usage_type.title: Usage Type

RecurringResponse.title: RecurringResponse

TransformQuantityResponse.description: Apply a transformation to the reported usage or set quantity before computing the amount billed.

round.description: After division, either round the result 'up' or 'down'.
round.title: Round

TransformQuantityResponse.title: TransformQuantityResponse
